# Purpose

Describe the problem and the behavior this change provides.

## Compatibility And Privacy

- [ ] Breaking changes or migration steps are documented.
- [ ] Public visitor access remains separate from owner authorization.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, private knowledge, or unsupported sample assets are included.

## Validation Actually Performed

- [ ] Focused and relevant full Python tests
- [ ] Type checks, Ruff, and Black
- [ ] Frontend TypeScript/build/Prettier, when applicable
- [ ] Explicit mocked browser tests, when applicable
- [ ] Documentation lint and local links

List results and any checks not run. Distinguish offline/mock checks from image builds, real-device checks, and live deployment validation.
